help.title: Writing notes help
help.intro: A quick guide to the blocks, formulas, and shortcuts available in the editor.
help.blockHint: Use /formula for large formulas. You do not need to type $$, although Entropi also accepts $$…$$, \[...\], and the equation environment when pasting existing content.
help.formattingDescription: Select any text to open the floating toolbar. You can combine styles, colors, highlights, alignment, and links.
help.colorDescription: The colors button can change the text color or apply a highlighted background.
help.inlineCodeDescription: Use the code button for variable names, functions, commands, or short snippets inside a sentence.
help.startDescription: Inline formulas live inside a sentence. Display formulas occupy their own line and support larger structures.
help.structureDescription: Use braces to group expressions. Superscripts and subscripts apply to the group that follows them.
help.calculusDescription: Ordinary and partial derivatives, single or multiple integrals, limits, and sums.
help.linearAlgebraDescription: Separate columns with & and rows with \\. Fractions and symbols can be nested inside each cell.
help.matrixTypes: Available environments: matrix, pmatrix (parentheses), bmatrix (brackets), Bmatrix (braces), vmatrix (determinant), and Vmatrix (norm). You can also wrap matrix with \left and \right to combine custom delimiters such as \langle, \rangle, |, \Vert, \lfloor, or \lceil.
help.alignmentDescription: Use aligned to develop an equation over several lines and cases for piecewise functions.
help.alignmentMarkers: The & symbol marks the alignment point—usually before =—and \\ starts a new row.
help.systemHint: For a system, combine a left brace with aligned; an augmented matrix uses a vertical separator between coefficients and results.
help.textSpacingDescription: Math mode ignores many normal spaces. Use spacing commands and \text{...} for words.
help.symbolsDescription: Type the symbol name after a backslash. Uppercase Greek letters start with a capital letter, for example \Delta.
help.slashDescription: Type / on an empty line to open the block library and filter it by name.
help.canvasCommand: Insert a canvas for drawing, shapes, and axes.
help.libraryCommand: Show every available block in the library.
help.inlineDescription: Wrap the expression in $ signs and continue typing. Double-click the formula to edit it.
help.latexSupported: You can also use Greek letters, integrals, sums, products, infinity, vectors, and relations such as ≤, ≥, and ≈.
help.copyHint: Tap any example to copy its code.
